legend: There is a hidden binary string s$$$s$$$ of length n$$$n$$$. It is guaranteed that s$$$s$$$ contains at least one character 1, and you wish to find a 1.
In each query, you may ask if a substring slsl+1…sr$$$s_ls_{l+1} \ldots s_r$$$ contains a 1. However, there is an additional restriction:
If your previous query had length L$$$L$$$, then every future query must have length at least L$$$L$$$. In other words, the sequence of query lengths must be nondecreasing.
Find the index of any character 1 using at most 100$$$100$$$ queries.
The length of a query ?lr$$$\texttt{?}\;l\; r$$$ is defined as r−l+1$$$r - l + 1$$$.
input: At the beginning of the interaction, you are given a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤104$$$1\le n\le 10^4$$$) — the length of the hidden string.
It is guaranteed that the hidden string contains no characters other than 0s and 1s, and that it contains at least one 1.
To make a query, print a line in the following format:
?lr$$$\texttt{?}\;l\;r$$$ (1≤l≤r≤n$$$1\le l\le r\le n$$$) — the indices chosen for the query.
After you print a query, the interactor will respond with a single integer:
1 if the substring slsl+1…sr$$$s_l s_{l+1}\ldots s_r$$$ contains at least one 1;
When you are ready to give the final answer, print a line of the form
! p$$$p$$$, where 1≤p≤n$$$1\le p\le n$$$ and sp=1$$$s_p=\texttt{1}$$$,
If you make an invalid query, ask more than 100$$$100$$$ queries, or break the nondecreasing-length rule, the interactor may reply with -1. In that case, your program must terminate immediately.
Note that the final answer does not count as a query.

After printing each query do not forget to output the end of line and flush∗$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$ the output. Otherwise, you will get Idleness limit exceeded verdict. If, at any interaction step, you read −1$$$-1$$$ instead of valid data, your solution must exit immediately. This means that your solution will receive Wrong answer because of an invalid query or any other mistake. Failing to exit can result in an arbitrary verdict because your solution will continue to read from a closed stream.
The interactor is not adaptive; the hidden string is fixed before the interaction starts.
see the documentation for other languages.
note: The hidden string in this test is 00100001.
Note that the lengths of the three queries are 1$$$1$$$, 3$$$3$$$, and 3$$$3$$$ in order. Because s8=1$$$s_8 = \texttt{1}$$$, the answer to the query ?68$$$\texttt{?}\;6\;8$$$ is 1$$$1$$$.

legend.ai: 存在一个长度为 n$$$n$$$ 的隐藏二进制字符串 s$$$s$$$。保证 s$$$s$$$ 至少包含一个字符 1，你希望找到一个 1。
在每次查询中，你可以询问子串 slsl+1…sr$$$s_ls_{l+1} \ldots s_r$$$ 是否包含 1。不过，还有一项额外限制：
如果你上一次查询的长度为 L$$$L$$$，那么之后的每次查询长度都必须至少为 L$$$L$$$。换句话说，查询长度序列必须是非递减的。
找出任意一个字符 1 的下标，最多使用 100$$$100$$$ 次查询。
查询 ?lr$$$\texttt{?}\;l\; r$$$ 的长度定义为 r−l+1$$$r - l + 1$$$。

input.ai: 在交互开始时，你会得到一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤104$$$1\le n\le 10^4$$$)——隐藏字符串的长度。
保证隐藏字符串中除了 0 和 1 外不含其他字符，且至少包含一个 1。
进行一次查询时，请按以下格式输出一行：
?lr$$$\texttt{?}\;l\;r$$$(1≤l≤r≤n$$$1\le l\le r\le n$$$)— 查询所选的下标。
输出查询后，交互器将回复一个整数：
如果子串 slsl+1…sr$$$s_l s_{l+1}\ldots s_r$$$ 中至少包含一个 1，则为 1；
当你准备给出最终答案时，请输出如下形式的一行
如果你进行了无效查询、查询次数超过 100$$$100$$$ 次，或违反了长度非递减规则，交互器可能会回复 -1。此时，你的程序必须立即终止。
注意，最终答案不计入查询次数。
输出每次查询后，不要忘记输出行末并刷新∗$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$输出。否则，你将得到 Idleness limit exceeded 判定。如果在任意交互步骤中，你读取到 −1$$$-1$$$ 而不是有效数据，你的解必须立即退出。这意味着你的解会因无效查询或其他错误而收到 Wrong answer。未能退出可能会导致任意判定，因为你的解将继续从已关闭的流中读取数据。
